P.name: Unseen Predator
P.title: Template:Data Rengar/Unseen Predator
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Unseen Predator|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Rengar |skill = I |icon = false |icon3 = Unseen Predator.png |icon4 = Bonetooth Necklace.png |blurbicon = Unseen Predator.png |blurb = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Rengar}} generates {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} when he casts a basic ability or uses ''{{ais|Savagery|Rengar}}'' empowered attack, which expires after a period [[out of combat]]. At max {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}}, his next basic ability consumes them to become empowered with an additional effect, gain an extra cast, and briefly grant him {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Innate - Bonetooth Necklace:}} '''Rengar''' generates a permanent [[File:Bonetooth Necklace.png|20px|link=]] ''Trophy'' stack for each unique {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}. |blurb3 = {{sbc|Innate:}} While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Rengar''' gains ''Unseen Predator''. |blurb4 = {{sbc|Unseen Predator:}} '''Rengar's''' basic {{sti|attack range}} is increased and causes him to {{tip|dash|leap}} to the target. This generates {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} {{tip|on-hit}} if he had none at one point. |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon casting a {{tip|Champion ability|basic ability}} or using ''{{ais|Savagery|Rengar}}'' first attack, '''Rengar''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} for {{tt|1 second|counting from the end of attack windup or cast time}}, stacking up 4 times but not refreshing on subsequent triggers {{bug|2}}. At maximum stacks, his next basic ability consumes them all to become empowered with an additional effect and grant him an additional cast along with {{sti|ms|{{pp|key=%|30 to 50 for 3|1 to 13|color=ms}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Generated {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} is prevented from expiring for 10 seconds after dealing or taking damage, excluding damage dealt by [[damage over time]] or [[Damage#Engine_level|proc]] effects. |description2 = {{sbc|Innate:}} While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Rengar''' gains ''Unseen Predator'', which lingers for {{fd|0.35}} seconds upon exiting brush. ''Unseen Predator'' is lost immediately if '''Rengar''' exits the brush using {{si|Flash}} or {{si|Hexflash}}. |description3 = {{sbc|Unseen Predator:}} '''Rengar's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}} generates {{as|1 Ferocity|buzzword3}} if none of his {{tt|{{as|current Ferocity|buzzword3}} was generated this way|The next use of Unseen Predator after consuming all Ferocity from an empowered ability will count for this effect}}. The attack also has massively increased range and causes him to {{tip|dash|leap}} to the target's location if they are beyond his normal basic attack range, attacking the target upon arrival and landing 50 units in front of them.

'''''Rengar''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash. The start of the leap is the end of '''Rengar's''' {{tip|attack windup}}, putting the attack timer on cooldown, triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects and additionally refreshing the {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} duration.'' |description4 = {{Anchor|Bonetooth Necklace}}{{sbc|Innate - Bonetooth Necklace:}} Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them grants '''Rengar''' a ''Trophy'', once per unique champion and up to 5. An additional ''Trophy'' is made available through the event ''[[The Hunt is On!]]'' with the [[File:Head of Kha'Zix.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Head of Kha'Zix''. ''Trophies'' grant {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Bonetooth Necklace.png|20px|border|adjustsize|link=]] Trophies|key=%|x^2 for 6|x;Head of Kha'Zix|formula=(Number of Trophies) * (Number of Trophies)}} '''bonus''' AD}}. |range = {{tt|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} 745 (+ 100% '''bonus''' {{sti|attack range}})|see notes for exceptions}} |target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|50|Landing distance from target's location at dash start, determines dash length}} |speed = 1450 |targeting = Passive |affects = Self |damagetype = |spellshield = |spelleffects = |grounded = special |knockdown = True |parry = True |notes = * '''Rengar''' has a secondary resource bar that indicates how much {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} he currently has as pips. ** {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} generated by ''Unseen Predator'' has a purple color. ** Ferocity generated by his other abilities has a white color. {{safesubst:unexpected|desc= * While out of combat, if abilities are used one after the other, only the first will count towards the 1 second {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} timer, without refreshing from the second cast. [https://github.com/ArdaSenyurek/Rengar-Bugs/issues/104] {{bug|2|Appeared undocumented on V26.01}}|affectedEffects=Rengar I|estimatedPatchOrigin=V26.01|wikiUploadTimestamp=1776018778|pagename=Template:Data Rengar/Unseen Predator }} {{safesubst:unexpected|desc= * Reaching 4 {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} with an ability immediatelly grants access to empowered abilities, however reaching it with a brush attack will grant the access after a short delay - causing '''Rengar''' to still be able to cast normal abilities while at 4 {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}}. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r_mNm0YNmno] [https://github.com/ArdaSenyurek/Rengar-Bugs/issues/90] {{bug|2}}|affectedEffects=Rengar I|estimatedPatchOrigin=V12.6|wikiUploadTimestamp=1776216303|pagename=Template:Data Rengar/Unseen Predator }} * Only {{si|Flash}} and {{si|Hexflash}} instantly end ''Unseen Predator''. Other {{tip|blink}} effects will still cause the buff to linger upon exiting the {{tip|brush}} area. * The attack deals {{tip|basic damage}} but is considered {{tip|ability damage}} for {{ii|Spear of Shojin}}. * While {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}, '''Rengar''' loses the enhanced {{sti|attack range}} from ''Unseen Predator''. * {{iis|Rapid Firecannon}} and {{ais|Savagery|Rengar}} '''bonus''' ranges are lost after {{fd|0.25}} seconds upon gaining ''Unseen Predator'', and are re-gained after {{fd|0.25}} seconds upon losing ''Unseen Predator''. ** The same does not apply for other '''bonus''' ranges such as {{iis|Hexoptics C44}}. * '''Rengar''' will only leap to a target if his basic attack timer has been refreshed (if not so he will not automatically attempt to path towards his target, despite them being within leap range). {{safesubst:unexpected|desc= * The leap will consume {{tip|energized}} {{tip|on-attack}} but only expend it once the leap hits. ** If the leap is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, the ''energized'' will be indefinitely stored in the background until expended by a successive leap. Only 1 ''energized'' may be stored, but another can continue to recharge on the buffbar. *** While the ''energized'' is stored, normal basic attacks are prevented from expending any energized, however abilities may still expend the one from the buffbar. [https://github.com/ArdaSenyurek/Rengar-Bugs/issues/120] {{bug|2|Started on V26.02}}|affectedEffects=Rengar I; Energized|estimatedPatchOrigin=V26.02|wikiUploadTimestamp=1776293554|pagename=Template:Data Rengar/Unseen Predator }} * '''Rengar''' can freely use any {{tip|abilities}}, [[summoner spell]]s, or [[active ability items|item actives]] while leaping. ** Using a {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|blink}} ability will interrupt the leap. * The attack from the leap will: ** ''Not'' go off if the dash was interrupted. ** ''Not'' go off if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}. ** Go off at the end of the dash even if its normal destination is obstructed by boundaries he cannot cross (e.g. terrain, {{ai|The Hextech Ultimatum|Camille}}). ** Go off regardless of distance the enemy travels away from '''Rengar's''' original location. ** Go off even if '''Rengar''' loses {{tip|sight}} of the target. * {{as|{{sti|ad|Bonus AD}}|ad}} percent from ''Bonetooth Necklace'' [[recursion|stacks recursively]] with {{bi|Infernal Might}}, {{iis|Overlord's Bloodmail}} {{nie|Tyranny}} and [[Role Quests#Quests|mid lane quest's]] {{as|bonus AD}} multiplier. * ''Bonetooth Necklace'' uses different icons corresponding to the number of stacks acquired: ** {{sbc|1 Stack:}} [[File:Bonetooth Necklace.png|20px|border|link=]] ** {{sbc|2 Stacks:}} [[File:Bonetooth Necklace 2.png|20px|border|link=]] ** {{sbc|3 Stacks:}} [[File:Bonetooth Necklace 3.png|20px|border|link=]] ** {{sbc|4 Stacks:}} [[File:Bonetooth Necklace 4.png|20px|border|link=]] ** {{sbc|5 Stacks:}} [[File:Bonetooth Necklace 5.png|20px|border|link=]] ** {{sbc|6th Stack:}} [[File:Head of Kha'Zix item.png|20px|border|link=]] '''Head of Kha'Zix''' |tips = * Since the attack timer is only put on cooldown at the start of the leap, '''Rengar''' can {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} it mid leap (i.e via {{ai|Savagery|Rengar}}) to immediatelly perform a successive attack after leap end has hit. |flavorsound = {{sm2|Rengar_Original_PStackThree_0.ogg}} ''"Spoils of the hunt!"'' }}
